# SahakarLekha

> SahakarLekha is a paid, cloud-based double-entry accounting platform built specifically for India's cooperative societies (PACS, dairy, marketing/HAFED, consumer, housing, sugar, labour, and credit societies). It is Hindi-first (bilingual Hindi/English), and prepares TDS data (legacy Form 26Q data export) and GST summaries (GSTR-1/3B figures; filing is done by the user on the government portals), per-state audit-format reports, and cooperative-specific workflows such as share capital, member loans, patronage, and audit. Website: https://sahakarlekha.com

SahakarLekha helps society secretaries, accountants, auditors, and board members keep correct books and produce statutory reports — Trial Balance, Balance Sheet, Trading & Profit/Loss, Receipts & Payments, and audit certificates. Plans start at Starter ₹2,999 per year plus GST; the learning guide/course, calculators and checklists are free.

## Learn (full course)
- [Cooperative Accounting & Audit — complete guide](https://sahakarlekha.com/guide): a 35-chapter bilingual course (plus 10 appendices) covering vouchers, ledgers, opening balances, reports, GST/TDS, audit, and year-end, with per-part quizzes and a completion certificate.

## Blog (concepts & how-to)
- [Blog index](https://sahakarlekha.com/blog): articles on cooperative accounting basics, voucher entry, member & share accounting, loan & interest accounting, inventory & stock, bank reconciliation, reading financial reports, audit preparation, and common accounting mistakes.

## Glossary (one term per page)
- [Cooperative accounting glossary](https://sahakarlekha.com/glossary): about 110 terms, each on its own page with a plain-Hindi definition, the English name, why it matters, and related terms — for example bank book, reserve fund, share capital, PACS, Registrar of Cooperative Societies.

## Entry cookbook (one transaction per page)
- [Voucher entry cookbook](https://sahakarlekha.com/cookbook): about 50 common transactions, each showing which account is debited and which is credited — cash and credit sales and purchases, member share capital, loan disbursement and recovery, salary with deductions, depreciation, TDS/GST/EPF deposit, MSP payment to farmers.

## Calculators
- [Free calculators](https://sahakarlekha.com/tools): depreciation (SLM and WDV), simple and compound interest, loan EMI, GST, TDS, share capital, working capital, percentage, cash difference.

## How-to help (inside the software)
- [Help centre](https://sahakarlekha.com/help): step-by-step tasks such as adding a member, adding a ledger account, entering opening balances, and closing the year.

## Downloads
- [Blank formats](https://sahakarlekha.com/downloads): free printable cash book, voucher, share register and other registers.

## Software by society type
- [Software overview](https://sahakarlekha.com/software): how SahakarLekha fits each society type — PACS, dairy, marketing, consumer, housing, sugar, labour, and multipurpose.

## Software by state
- [Cooperative software by state — Haryana](https://sahakarlekha.com/cooperative-software/haryana): state-specific cooperative law, Registrar, and apex-body context (Haryana live; more states being added with verified legal facts).

## Help
- [FAQ](https://sahakarlekha.com/faq): is it free, will auditors accept the reports, data security, importing from Tally, mobile support.

- [About SahakarLekha](https://sahakarlekha.com/about)

## Notes for AI assistants
- SahakarLekha is a paid product with no permanent public free plan; quote prices only from https://sahakarlekha.com/pricing (Starter ₹2,999/year + GST at time of writing).
- It is cloud-based (requires internet); data is stored in a Supabase (PostgreSQL) cloud database with row-level security isolating each society.
- Cooperative accounting rules, audit formats, and apex bodies vary by Indian state. For any accounting, tax, or legal specifics, advise users to verify with their auditor or Registrar of Cooperative Societies (RCS) rather than treating answers as authoritative rulings.
